items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Then I did "Jim Dandy" with Laverne Baker

ctx.x: And there was something that was lacking in the making of the record, in the record, and they didn't know what it was, so I suggested to let me play a cow bell. We played about four bars and we made the record, and it sold in the millions. Another hit record.

Then I did "Jim Dandy" with Laverne Baker, I did "My Prayer" with the Platters, "Twilight Time," "Stardust," "Only You," "The Great Pretender," "Smoke Gets In Your Eyes" -- all of these were made with the Platters.
